scope_of_deliverables.value: Cowichan Tribes is procuring a cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to enhance operational efficiency across finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management functions, replacing specific TIFIS capabilities while retaining other TIFIS processes for housing, membership, and social services.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: Cowichan Tribes is seeking to procure a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across key functions including finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The solution should be aligned with industry best practice, provide features to automate processes, provide staff and leadership access to the information needed to effectively plan and operate, and be adaptable to evolving business needs. pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a pricing formula using the rates set out in the Proponent's submitted Pricing Sheet (Attachment 2). Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (price threshold ÷ proponent's price) × weighting = proponent's pricing points. Note on Threshold: Cowichan Tribes will not be publishing the price threshold that will be used in this calculation. However, the threshold will be based upon the projected costs and budget available for the implementation, licensing, and support of their ERP for the next five years. Submission format: A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G. Template for workbook provided. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes. Unless otherwise indicated in the requested pricing information, rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law. Pricing (see Section G below) has a weighting of 15 points and a threshold of 10.5 (70%) in the Evaluation Criteria table.

references_required.quote: At least two and at most five references for implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada. Preference is for references to be First Nation clients.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: At the conclusion of the evaluation, Cowichan Tribes will conduct a cumulative assessment and invite the top two or three vendors to provide a demonstration at their discretion. Vendors selected for the demonstration stage will be required to present their proposed solutions in accordance with the demo script that will be provided by Cowichan Tribes.
